north_star.test: Any agent task can be routed, run, paid for and checked without Frank reading the transcript, and the receipt shows which model and harness did it and what it cost.

pillars.name: Routing Brain
pillars.moat: Our own data on which model wins which task class at what cost. Nobody can rent this.
pillars.metric: Cost per accepted task, per class, from receipts
pillars.state: Hardened and under review (draft PR 377). Live ledger holds only synthetic test receipts, so no real measurement exists yet.

pillars.name: Harness tech
pillars.moat: A harness-neutral runner: any harness (opencode, pi, omo, fx) runs the same task suite and is judged on the same receipts.
pillars.metric: Accepted tasks per dollar and per minute, by harness, same model
pillars.state: Candidates identified. Nothing has been compared yet.

pillars.name: Cloud workers
pillars.moat: Work continues while the laptop is off, with a hard budget and a receipt for every job.
pillars.metric: Monthly cost at a stated job volume, and time from trigger to first action
pillars.state: Plan only. Railway MCP connector is available. Sleep and pricing behaviour unverified.

pillars.name: Starlight ecosystem
pillars.moat: oh-my-starlight: our own config, governance and receipts pack on top of upstream tools, in a free profile and a Token Pass profile. We own the pack, not a fork.
pillars.metric: Pass rate of the free profile per class; number of estate projects running on the pack
pillars.state: Generator exists. Profiles not split yet.
